name: Spanish Padel Federation
summary: Spain's national padel federation, one of the three national bodies (with Argentina and Uruguay) that founded the International Padel Federation in Madrid in 1991.

founded.editorNote: Not verified on 2026-10-25: the federation's own site (padelfederacion.es) did not respond (connection reset / DNS failure), so its founding date could not be read. FIP lists its affiliation year as 1991 (federation page).

headquarters.editorNote: Not verified on 2026-10-25: padelfederacion.es could not be loaded; the FIP directory page gives no address.

name: Asociación Pádel Argentino
summary: Argentina's national padel association, a founding member of the International Padel Federation in 1991 alongside Spain and Uruguay. It runs national rankings and junior circuits.

founded.editorNote: Not verified on 2026-10-25: padel.org.ar gives no founding date on its home, contact or board pages; FIP lists its affiliation year as 1991.

headquarters.editorNote: Not verified on 2026-10-25: padel.org.ar lists email contacts only, no address.

name: Svenska Padelförbundet
summary: Sweden's national padel federation, which promotes and administers padel in Sweden and represents Swedish padel abroad. It has been a member of the Swedish Sports Confederation (RF) since 2021 and joined the FIP in 2010.

founded.editorNote: Not verified on 2026-10-25: no founding date found on svenskpadel.se or in its 2025 statutes; FIP lists its affiliation year as 2010.

headquarters.editorNote: Not verified on 2026-10-25: svenskpadel.se gives only a c/o invoicing address in Kävlinge, not a head office.

name: Federação Portuguesa de Padel
summary: Portugal's national padel federation, based in Lisbon and affiliated to the FIP since 2005.

founded.editorNote: Not verified on 2026-10-25: fppadel.pt's history page ('Padel em Portugal') describes the sport's growth but gives no founding date for the federation; FIP lists its affiliation year as 2005.

name: Federación Mexicana de Pádel
summary: Mexico's national padel federation, based in Mérida, Yucatán, in the country the FIP calls the birthplace of padel. It has been affiliated to the FIP since 1992.

founded.editorNote: Not verified on 2026-10-25: no founding date found on femepa.app; FIP lists its affiliation year as 1992.

headquarters.citation: Aviso de privacidad (privacy notice), registered address

name: Padel Belgium
summary: Belgium's national padel association, affiliated to the FIP, which works through two regional leagues, Padel Vlaanderen in Flanders and a French-speaking league in Wallonia and Brussels. The current association was founded in 2022; Belgium's first padel federation dates from 1992.

founded.text: 2022 (current association); the first Belgian padel federation was created in 1992
founded.editorNote: FIP's federation page lists Belgium's affiliation year as 1996.

headquarters.editorNote: Address given as Louizapoortgalerij 203 bus 3, 1050 Brussel.

name: Qatar Padel Federation
summary: Qatar's national padel federation, based at the Khalifa International Tennis and Squash Complex in Doha and affiliated to the FIP since 2022. Doha is also the seat of Padel Asia.

founded.editorNote: Not verified on 2026-10-25: qatarpadel.com gives no founding date; FIP lists its affiliation year as 2022.

headquarters.text: Khalifa International Tennis and Squash Complex, Qatar

name: USA Padel
summary: The national governing body for padel in the United States, recognised by the FIP and Padel America, and formerly called the United States Padel Association. It is a not-for-profit run by a volunteer president and board, sanctions tournaments including the US Open Padel Championships, and selects the national teams.

founded.editorNote: Not verified on 2026-10-25: padelusa.org's About page gives no founding date (it says padel arrived in the USA in 1993); FIP lists its affiliation year as 1994.

headquarters.editorNote: Not verified on 2026-10-25: no address found on padelusa.org's home or About pages.

nameChange.text: Formerly the United States Padel Association
nameChange.editorNote: No date for the change is given.

name: Asociación de Padel del Uruguay
summary: Uruguay's governing body for padel, run by the Asociación de Amigos del Padel del Uruguay (AAP). Uruguay was one of the three founding nations of the FIP in 1991; the earlier national federation lapsed around 1999, leaving the AAP as the country's only official padel institution.

founded.text: Legal personality granted by Uruguay's Ministry of Education and Culture in 2000; the group behind it began in the mid-1990s

headquarters.editorNote: Not verified on 2026-10-25: padel.com.uy's contact page gives a form only, no address.

alsoKnownAs: Asociación de Amigos del Padel del Uruguay

name: Confederação Brasileira de Pádel
summary: Brazil's national padel confederation, affiliated to the FIP since 1994. Padel reached Brazil in 1988, and the country's first state federation, in Rio Grande do Sul, was founded in 1992.

founded.editorNote: Not verified on 2026-10-25: cobrapa.com.br's history page covers padel in Brazil but gives no founding date for the confederation; FIP lists its affiliation year as 1994.

headquarters.editorNote: Not verified on 2026-10-25: no address found on cobrapa.com.br's home or history pages.

name: Deutscher Padel Verband
summary: Germany's national padel federation, a registered association based in Hamburg that runs the German padel leagues and national teams. It has been affiliated to the FIP since 2005.

founded.editorNote: Not verified on 2026-10-25: no founding date found on dpv-padel.de's Über uns or Impressum pages; FIP lists its affiliation year as 2005.

headquarters.editorNote: Office at Havighorster Weg 16, 21031 Hamburg; registered at the Amtsgericht Hamburg (VR 2608 B).

name: Dansk Padel Forbund
summary: Denmark's national padel federation, based at Idrættens Hus in Brøndby. A first association applied to join the FIP in 2009 but went dormant; the federation was re-established in August 2017 and has been affiliated to the FIP since 2018.

founded.text: Re-established in August 2017 at a founding general meeting; an earlier Danish Padel Association first applied to join the FIP in July 2009

headquarters.text: Idrættens Hus, Brøndby Stadion 20, Brøndby, Denmark

name: Suomen Padelliitto
summary: Finland's national padel federation, a member of the Finnish Olympic Committee and of the FIP (since 2017), based in Helsinki. Its members are registered padel clubs and sports clubs with a padel section.

founded.editorNote: Not verified on 2026-10-25: no founding date found on padel.fi; FIP lists its affiliation year as 2017.

name: Padel Europe
summary: The European continental association for padel, set up within the FIP by 31 national federations at the FIP European Padel Championships in Cagliari in July 2024. Based in Spain, it had 41 member federations by July 2025.

founded.text: 25 July 2024, when representatives of 31 national federations agreed its constitution during the FIP European Padel Championships
founded.editorNote: The FIP's July 2025 report places the signing in Cagliari.

headquarters.citation: News, 10 July 2025: headquarters officially established in Spain

name: Padel America
summary: The continental association for padel in the Americas, set up within the FIP in August 2024 by the federations of Argentina, Brazil, Canada, Chile, Mexico, Paraguay and the United States. It is based in Mexico and open to every American FIP federation.

founded.text: August 2024, constituted by the federations of Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Canada, Mexico, the United States and Paraguay

members.editorNote: Not verified on 2026-10-25: the founding article lists seven founding federations but no FIP page found gives a current member count.

name: Padel Asia
summary: The Asian continental association for padel, established within the FIP and announced at the FIP's 34th General Assembly in Doha, with its board confirmed in December 2024. It is based in Doha, Qatar.

founded.text: Announced at the 34th FIP General Assembly in Doha; board of directors confirmed in December 2024

members.editorNote: Not verified on 2026-10-25: no FIP page found gives Padel Asia's member count.
